rationale: The core graph (associated_with, binds, interacts_with, participates_in, translates_to) was adopted as the default submission graph: keep every association, prune only structural defects, and reject phenotype or ontology edges, evidence filters and confidence weighting in the core. The compact phenotype profile was left as a branch-scoped variant at that point.
subject: P-13
title: Adopt the core five-relation graph as the submission graph (CD-0007)
